work.description: Brief LXXIX to the bishop of Parma (address LF14039–14040) frees the Parma chapter’s Mass obligations from fixed days and altars and grants a privileged altar; LF14051 Par- → LF14060 mae across the page-96 running title LF14054 and a column mark LF14057; LF14122 → LF14128 across own provenance LF14125; LF14174 ce- | → LF14179 lebratum: the OCR emits LF14175–14176 (rum damnatos … satis per), which native geometry places in the right column beside LF14174 as body of letter LXXX (between LF14261 and LF14264), and they are excluded as another act’s text; this brief’s own words are complete and in order; LF14197 → LF14206 across page-97 running title LF14200 and page number LF14203; complete 5 February 1836 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF14043–14043; the source closing at LF14225–14228 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die quinta februarii millesimo octin- gentesimo. trigesimo sexto, pontificatus No- stri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
